- Keep the final answer under approximately 250 words.

- [x] Identified that the most direct path ($100 + 75 = 175$) is forbidden.

3. Re-evaluate factoring 198 ($9 \times 22$, $6 \times 33$, $11 \times 18$) to see if any of those components can be constructed.

- Target: 198
